set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged 1iep receptor + ligand against pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' f13cf3b36f61d87c3b58983e0b8ecf1c3456a685eb86dfe9ccfb139c7bdc2586 1iep_receptor.pdbqt > pins.sha256
printf '%s  %s\n' 15fb35648d8c18c70317842f3a0631b73a19429c710a037ab07310084d579bb8 1iep_ligand.pdbqt >> pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== AutoDock Vina: dock imatinib into Abl kinase (1iep), fixed seed, twice =="
cat > dock.py <<'EOF'
from vina import Vina
import json
def dock(seed):
    # cpu is PINNED, not just the seed. Vina parallelises its Monte Carlo search, so the
    # thread count changes the search trajectory and therefore the top pose -- the same rule
    # this catalog applies to IQ-TREE, Flye and muscle. A fixed seed alone is not enough for
    # a number that must hold on another box.
    v = Vina(sf_name='vina', seed=seed, cpu=2, verbosity=0)
    v.set_receptor('1iep_receptor.pdbqt')
    v.set_ligand_from_file('1iep_ligand.pdbqt')
    v.compute_vina_maps(center=[15.190,53.903,16.917], box_size=[20,20,20])
    v.dock(exhaustiveness=32, n_poses=5)
    return v.energies(n_poses=5)
e1 = dock(42)
e2 = dock(42)
json.dump({"top1": float(e1[0][0]), "top2": float(e2[0][0]), "n_poses": len(e1)},
          open("dock.json","w"))
print("TOP1", e1[0][0], "TOP2", e2[0][0], "N", len(e1))
EOF
python3 dock.py > dock.log 2>&1

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import json, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
d=json.load(open("dock.json"))
t1,t2,n=d["top1"],d["top2"],d["n_poses"]
# top affinity reproduces the published v1.2.7 basic-docking tutorial result for 1iep
# (imatinib in Abl kinase): reference top pose -13.234 kcal/mol. Band allows for MC
# search noise across hosts; a failed dock lands near 0 or positive.
# TWO separate claims, both tighter than the old +/-0.5 band.
# (1) Reproducible: with seed AND cpu pinned, three runs across three instances all gave
#     -13.207. Without the cpu pin that number is a property of the box, not the recipe.
check("top_affinity_pinned", abs(t1 - (-13.207)) < 1e-3,
      f"{t1:.3f} kcal/mol  want -13.207 +/-0.001 (seed+cpu pinned; 3 runs, 3 instances)")
# (2) Agreement with AutoDock Vina's OWN published v1.2.7 tutorial result. The tolerance is
#     set by what the reference is: a docked-pose affinity quoted to 3 decimals from a
#     stochastic search, so 0.05 kcal/mol is tight enough to catch a wrong receptor, box or
#     ligand and loose enough not to depend on our exact thread count matching theirs.
check("vs_published_v127", abs(t1 - (-13.234)) < 0.05,
      f"|{t1:.3f} - (-13.234)| = {abs(t1-(-13.234)):.3f}  want < 0.05 kcal/mol")
# reproducibility identity: same seed -> identical result (proves --seed controls the MC)
check("deterministic_seed", abs(t1-t2)<1e-6, f"|{t1:.3f} - {t2:.3f}| < 1e-6 (fixed seed is deterministic)")
check("poses_returned", n>=3, f"{n}  want >= 3 poses")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
